source: FOUNDER TEMPLATE - every rule LOW, no parameter set; the founder ratifies (MED/HIGH), fixes, or kills each rule and fills its parameters. Nothing here is a default.

H1.question: Minimum RN count by census band (low, normal, high, surge). Is charge ever also counted in the H1 number? What happens when the band is missing or unknown: skip, refuse, or use a named band?

H2.question: A charge-qualified RN is present on every shift. Keep, fix or kill.

H4.question: A nurse marked UNAVAILABLE is never scheduled. Any exception (mandation, holiday rotation, disaster)? List the allowed exception tags, or [] for none.

H5.question: Minimum rest between shifts, in hours. Is a rest exactly equal to the minimum legal (inclusive)? Is day-after-night forbidden outright?

H6.question: Maximum consecutive shifts worked (twelves in a row, counted as consecutive days with a shift).

H9.question: No nurse assigned to two places in the same block. Which places (float, sitter, triage) do NOT count as a separate place? [] means every place counts.
